federated_ingest_page.seo_title: Federated Ingest — Bring Your Own Voice Agent
federated_ingest_page.seo_description: Federated Ingest lets external voice agents post calls, transcripts, and tool events into QVO over a simple HTTPS API — and inherit analytics, quality scoring, billing, and tool execution.

hero.title: Federated Ingest. Bring your own voice agent — keep one operations surface.
hero.description: Run any voice agent — proprietary, partner-built, or a legacy IVR — and forward its calls into QVO over a simple HTTPS API. Inherit analytics, quality scoring, billing, the tool execution engine, and the rest of the platform, without rebuilding anything you already shipped.

use_cases.heading: Three reasons teams use Federated Ingest
use_cases.subheading: You already built a voice agent — or bought one — and the last thing you want is to rip it out. Ingest plugs your existing stack into the QVO operations layer.

items.title: Run your own voice stack
items.desc: You operate a custom voice agent (proprietary STT/TTS, in-house orchestration, on-prem GPU). Post call sessions and events into QVO and inherit the analytics, billing, ticketing, and dispatch layers without rewriting anything.

items.title: Bring partner agents under one roof
items.desc: Shipping a vertical voice agent to your customers? Forward call data through QVO ingest so each customer sees a unified inbox alongside any other QVO-native agents they run.

items.title: Bridge legacy IVRs into AI
items.desc: Stream events from an existing contact-center platform so QVO can score quality, surface evolution suggestions, and roll metrics up to the same dashboards as new AI traffic.

ingest_steps.heading: Four steps from external call to unified operations
ingest_steps.code_caption: One POST per call. Idempotency keys make retries safe by default.

sample.transcript_assistant: Thanks for calling Lakeside Eye Care...
sample.transcript_user: I need to reschedule my Friday appointment.

items.title: Mint a federated API key
items.desc: Each external agent gets a tenant-scoped key from the developer portal. Keys are revocable, scoped to /ingest/* only, and rotate on demand.

items.title: POST events to /ingest/*
items.desc: Send call sessions, transcripts, tool calls, and outcome metadata. You supply your own idempotency token per request — independent of external_id — so safe retries and explicit corrections are both first-class.

items.title: Inherit the QVO data model
items.desc: Ingested calls flow into the same call_session, transcript, and usage tables as native QVO calls — so analytics, exports, and Stripe metering “just work.”

items.title: Plug into the rest of the platform
items.desc: External calls show up in dashboards, Quality scoring, the ticket system, dispatch handoffs, GIN benchmarks, and the evolution engine alongside native traffic.

platform_benefits.heading: The whole QVO platform — without writing a second integration
platform_benefits.subheading: Federated calls become first-class citizens. Every product surface treats them exactly like a call routed through QVO's voice gateway.

items.title: Unified analytics
items.desc: External calls roll into the same volume, conversion, and quality charts as native QVO calls. No second dashboard to maintain.

items.title: Quality scoring out of the box
items.desc: Every ingested transcript is scored by the QVO QA engine. Compare your prompt revisions A/B against your peers in the same vertical.

items.title: Evolution engine suggestions
items.desc: QVO mines ingested transcripts for prompt improvements and surfaces them as proposed changes for your team to accept or reject.

items.title: One billing surface
items.desc: Federated minutes meter through Stripe alongside native usage. Customers get a single invoice, however the calls were delivered.

items.title: Tool execution bridge
items.desc: Hand off from your agent to QVO-managed tools (scheduling, ticketing, SMS, dispatch) in mid-call without round-tripping the customer.

items.title: Compliance inheritance
items.desc: Tenant RLS, audit log, PHI redaction in transcripts, and DSAR exports cover ingested data the same way they cover native calls.

security_section.heading: Security, idempotency, and rotation built into the protocol

items.title: Tenant-scoped API keys
items.desc: Federated keys are bound to a single tenant at issuance and cannot be reused across tenants — even if leaked.

items.title: Revocable + rotation reminders
items.desc: Keys can be revoked instantly from the developer portal. Rotation reminders surface in the audit log every 90 days.

items.title: Caller-supplied idempotency tokens
items.desc: Idempotency is keyed on (tenant_id, idempotency_key) — decoupled from external_id — so retries are safe and a fresh token can re-issue an explicit correction for the same call.

items.title: Backfill endpoint with attestation
items.desc: Live `/v1/ingest/calls` accepts events from the last 7 days; older traffic (up to 30 days) goes through `/v1/ingest/calls/backfill` with a signed attestation block recording who authorized the late ingest and why.

security_section.compliance_text: Federated ingest inherits the same SOC 2 controls, audit log coverage, RLS isolation, and DSAR exports as native QVO traffic.
security_section.compliance_followup: Have additional vertical requirements (HIPAA BAA, regional residency)? Our security team will scope it during onboarding.

bottom_cta.title: Ready to wire your agent into QVO?
bottom_cta.subtitle: Mint a federated key, post your first call, and watch it land in the same dashboards as the rest of your operations — usually in under an afternoon.

gin_page.seo_title: Global Intelligence Network — Cross-tenant Voice Benchmarks
gin_page.seo_description: The Global Intelligence Network (GIN) gives QVO tenants opt-in, anonymized benchmarks against vertical peers, and feeds the evolution engine with prompt patterns that demonstrably move the needle.

hero.title: Benchmark your voice operations against the rest of your industry — without sharing a single transcript.
hero.description: GIN is QVO's opt-in cross-tenant benchmark layer. See where your answer rate, booking conversion, dispatch latency, and quality scores sit against an anonymized cohort of peers in your vertical — and pull in the prompt patterns that put the top quartile ahead of you.

benchmark.heading: What a GIN benchmark looks like
benchmark.subheading: Sample comparisons from the live network. Numbers update on a daily rolling window so you're always comparing against current behavior.
benchmark.status_illustrative: Illustrative sample — live cohort coming soon
benchmark.status_preview: Preview cohort — early data, not yet published
benchmark.disclosure_illustrative: Sample figures shown for layout while the live cohort accumulates enough opted-in tenants to publish real benchmarks. Real cohort medians and top-quartile values replace these automatically once each (vertical, metric) cohort meets the k-anonymity threshold.
benchmark.disclosure_preview: Early cohort data — published in preview while we accumulate enough opted-in tenants per vertical for a stable benchmark.
benchmark.disclosure_live: Cohort medians and top-quartile values aggregated from opted-in QVO tenants in each vertical. Rows below the k-anonymity threshold are suppressed.
benchmark.disclosure_suffix: Cohorts only render when ≥ {{k}} tenants of comparable size are participating. Refresh: {{cadence}}.
benchmark.refresh_cadence: Daily rolling 30-day window once enough cohorts opt in
benchmark.footnote: Cohorts shown only when ≥ k tenants of comparable size are participating.

value_props.heading: A learning loop, not a leaderboard

items.title: See where you stand
items.desc: Compare your agents’ answer rate, conversion, dispatch latency, no-show rate, and quality scores against an anonymized cohort of QVO tenants in the same vertical and size band.

items.title: Learn from the top quartile
items.desc: When peer top performers crush a metric you struggle on, GIN surfaces concrete prompt and configuration patterns the cohort uses — never their identities.

items.title: Power the evolution engine
items.desc: GIN feeds the closed-loop prompt evolver: it proposes prompt changes that have measurably moved the needle elsewhere in your vertical, then A/B tests them on your traffic before promoting.

how_it_works.heading: Privacy-first by construction
how_it_works.subheading: GIN was designed to make sharing safe so that sharing happens. The defaults err on the side of suppression, not exposure.

items.title: Opt in per workspace
items.desc: GIN is opt-in by default. Toggle it on from Governance → Global Intelligence. You can opt out at any time and your data is removed from future cohorts.

items.title: k-anonymous aggregation
items.desc: Metrics are bucketed by vertical and tenant size. Cohorts always contain at least k tenants — your numbers are never identifiable, even by inference.

items.title: No transcripts ever leave
items.desc: Only numeric metrics, structured tags, and prompt-shape fingerprints contribute to GIN. Raw transcripts, PHI, and customer identifiers stay inside your tenant.

items.title: Refreshed on a rolling window
items.desc: Cohort baselines update on a daily rolling window so the benchmark you compare against reflects current behavior, not last quarter.

control_plane.heading: Six things you'll see in Governance → Global Intelligence

benefits.label: Vertical-aware benchmarks
benefits.desc: Healthcare, dental, legal, real estate, home services, hospitality.

benefits.label: Quartile rankings
benefits.desc: Where do you sit on each metric — bottom, middle, top?

benefits.label: Improvement targets
benefits.desc: See how much lift would move you up a quartile, with effort estimates.

benefits.label: Prompt-pattern hints
benefits.desc: Patterns top quartile peers use, never their wording or identity.

benefits.label: Cohort matching
benefits.desc: Compared against tenants in your vertical and call-volume tier — not the whole network.

benefits.label: Source-of-truth metrics
benefits.desc: Pulled from the same warehouse that powers your tenant analytics — no duplicate definitions.

control_plane.privacy_heading: Built for buyers who say "no" to data sharing
privacy_controls: Opt-in only — disabled by default for new workspaces.
Opt out at any time; your data is excluded from the next refresh and dropped from cached cohorts within 24 hours.
Per-vertical, per-size cohorts must contain at least k tenants before a benchmark renders. Below k, the chart is suppressed.
Only aggregate metrics, prompt-shape fingerprints, and tagged outcomes contribute. Raw transcripts and identifiers never leave your tenant.
Audit log records every GIN read, every opt-in/opt-out, and every prompt suggestion accepted from a peer cohort.
GIN data is excluded from your DSAR exports because it never contained personal data — but the audit log entries are included.

evolution_card.heading: The evolution engine, but smarter
evolution_card.desc: On its own, the QVO evolution engine A/B tests prompt revisions on your traffic. With GIN turned on, it starts those experiments from a candidate set already shown to lift conversion or quality elsewhere in your vertical — so you skip the exploration step and head straight for the gains.

bottom_cta.title: Want to see your numbers in context?
bottom_cta.subtitle: Book a demo and we'll walk you through a sample GIN benchmark for your vertical — and show you exactly what gets shared (and what never does).

vertical_agents_page.seo_title: Vertical Agents — Pre-built AI Voice Agents by Industry
vertical_agents_page.seo_description: QVO's catalog of vertical AI voice agents — from native ophthalmology agents like Azul Vision to medical, dental, field-service, legal, and real-estate templates. Pick a template, customize it, ship it.

hero.title: Pre-built voice agents for the verticals you actually work in.
hero.description: QVO ships native and template agents tuned to the way real practices and crews operate — ophthalmology, primary care, dental, HVAC, plumbing, law, and real estate — so you start from a working agent, not a blank prompt.

catalog.heading: The current catalog
catalog.subheading: Native agents are turn-key. Templates are starting points you customize for your practice or crew in the QVO Agent Builder.

agents.name: Azul Vision
agents.summary: A native ophthalmology agent that handles patient calls for cataract, LASIK, retina, and glaucoma practices end-to-end. Built by a clinical team, deployed inside QVO.
agents.source: Native QVO agent — runs inside the voice gateway with PHI redaction.

agents.name: Medical Front Desk
agents.summary: Patient scheduling, intake, prescription refills, and after-hours triage for primary care, urgent care, and specialty practices.
agents.source: Template — customize prompts, tools, and routing for your clinic.

agents.name: Dental Practice Agent
agents.summary: Books cleanings, confirms hygiene appointments, handles insurance verification, and reduces no-shows for general and cosmetic dental practices.
agents.source: Template — pre-tuned for Dentrix, Open Dental, and Eaglesoft.

agents.name: Field Service Dispatcher
agents.summary: Answers emergency service calls, prioritizes by urgency, and dispatches technicians with live ETA SMS to the customer.
capabilities: Technician matching by skill and location
agents.source: Template — wires into the QVO dispatch and SMS systems out of the box.

agents.name: Legal Intake Agent

agents.source: Template — designed with input from PI, family, and immigration firms.

what_you_get.heading: Six things you don't have to build yourself

items.title: Vertical-specific prompts
items.desc: Each agent ships with prompts written by people who actually work in that vertical — not a generic “medical receptionist” template applied across specialties.

items.title: Pre-wired tools
items.desc: Each template comes pre-wired to the right scheduling, EHR, MLS, dispatch, and CRM tools. No tool-by-tool plumbing on day one.

items.title: Vertical knowledge packs
items.desc: Glossaries, intake schemas, and FAQ libraries tuned to the vertical so the agent answers correctly from the first call.

items.title: Compliance defaults
items.desc: PHI redaction for healthcare, conflict-check for legal, TCPA quiet-hours for outbound — defaults match the vertical, not just the platform.

items.title: Vertical KPIs in your dashboard
items.desc: Each template surfaces the metrics that matter for that vertical (no-show rate, lead-to-tour, dispatch acceptance time) instead of generic call counts.

items.title: Evolution-engine ready
items.desc: Every template plugs into the QVO evolution engine and (optionally) the Global Intelligence Network for vertical-aware prompt suggestions.

deploy_steps.heading: Four steps from catalog to first live call

items.title: 1. Pick a template
items.desc: Browse the catalog above and choose the agent that matches your vertical. Native agents like Azul Vision are turn-key; templates are a starting point you customize.

items.title: 2. Customize in the Agent Builder
items.desc: Adjust prompts, add your knowledge documents, wire in your CRM/EHR, and set routing rules — all from the visual Agent Builder.

items.title: 3. Test on the live demo
items.desc: Call the agent yourself from the demo console, score the conversation, and iterate before pointing real numbers at it.

items.title: 4. Go live and learn
items.desc: Route a phone number to the agent. Quality scoring, evolution suggestions, and (opt-in) GIN benchmarks kick in immediately.

spotlight.heading: Azul Vision: a native, vertical-deep agent
spotlight.desc: Azul Vision is an ophthalmology agent built by clinicians and ported to run inside the QVO voice gateway — not a third-party agent forwarding events. That means the QVO Voice AI runtime, tool engine, and PHI redaction apply end-to-end to every call.
bullets: Pre-op and post-op patient education calls
Triage for retina, glaucoma, and post-op concerns
spotlight.partner_heading: Want a vertical-deep agent for your specialty?
spotlight.partner_desc: QVO partners with vertical experts to ship native agents for new specialties. If your team has the clinical or operational expertise and we have the runtime, we can co-build a Vertical Agent for your domain.

bottom_cta.title: Skip the blank prompt. Start with a vertical agent.
bottom_cta.subtitle: Spin up an agent that already knows your vertical. Customize what's specific to your practice, leave the rest as defaults, and go live in days, not months.
